title: Oprah Winfrey's 2008 Stanford Commencement Address
description:
Help us caption and translate this video on Amara.org: http://www.amara.org/en/v/3Vv/

Oprah Winfrey, global media leader and philanthropist, spoke to the Class of 2008 at Stanford's 117th Commencement on June 15, 2008.   Winfrey drew on experiences from a career that began in 1976 when she co-anchored a television newscast, and she shared three lessons about feelings, failure and finding happiness.

Transcript of Oprah Winfrey's commencement address: http://news-service.stanford.edu/news/2008/june18/como-061808.html

Stanford University channel on YouTube:
http://www.youtube.com/stanford

title: University of Waterloo campus tour
description:
Take to the sky by drone and journey through the University of Waterloo like it’s never been seen before.

Timestamp
0:00 University of Waterloo
• Canada’s innovation university 
• Founded in 1957 
• 100+ programs 
• 6 faculties: Arts, Engineering, Environment, Health, Mathematics, Science 
https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/

0:23 Tatham Centre (TC) / Co-op
• World’s largest co-op program of its kind 
• Up to two years of paid work experience 
• $8,400-$18,000 CAD in co-op earnings per term (2019)
• Professional skill development with an EDGE 
• Career workshops galore 
https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/co-op 

0:39 Faculty of Arts 
• 6 undergraduate programs 
• School of Accounting and Finance 
• Stratford School 
• Too many majors to list 
• Beloved mascot: Porcellino, a boar 
• Words to live by: Arts gets rowdy 
https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/arts

1:02 Dana Porter Library (DP) / Student Supports
• Student Success Office for personal development and academic support 
• AccessAbility Services for academic accommodations  
• Campus Wellness for Health Services and Counselling Services
https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/student-life/student-services

1:28 Faculty of Environment 
• 8 undergraduate programs 
• Largest Faculty of Environment in Canada 
• First LEED® Platinum certified campus building in Ontario 
• 5,000 sq ft rooftop garden patio 
• 2-storey living wall 
• Favourite colour: gotta be green 
https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/environment

1:51 Faculty of Mathematics 
• 20+ undergraduate programs 
• Only Faculty of Mathematics in North America  
• School of Computer Science  
• Tutorial Centres and Davis Centre Library 
• Famous fueling station: Math Coffee and Donuts (C&D) 
• Mascot: Pinkie, the pink tie 
https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/mathematics

2:19 Faculty of Health
• 7 undergraduate programs 
• Human cadaver lab 
• Spacious social and study spaces 
• Small first-year labs and tutorials 
• Life goals: Helping others live healthier lives 
https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/health

2:38 Columbia Ice Field (CIF) / Waterloo Athletics and Recreation
• Waterloo Warriors #goblackgogold 
• 30+ varsity teams 
• 2,500+ fitness classes each year 
• New 65,000 sq ft indoor field house 
• One of the largest student employers on campus 
https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/student-life/sports-recreation

3:02 University Colleges
• 4 University Colleges: St. Jerome’s, Renison, St. Paul’s, Conrad Grebel 
• Tight-knit communities in the heart of campus 
• Waterloo degree, with smaller classes and residence 
• Motto: Best of both worlds 
https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/university-colleges

3:20 Student Life Centre (SLC) / Student Experience
• Refueling station, games, information, and hangout zone 
• Waterloo Undergraduate Student Association (WUSA):  
                • student voice  
                • 11 services  
                • 250+ clubs  
                • countless events 
• Easy access to bus, light rail, and GO Transit 
https://wusa.ca/ 

3:37 Quantum-Nano Centre (QNC) / Entrepreneurship
• Learning and research, even on the subatomic level  
• Institute for Quantum Computing 
• Unique Intellectual Property (IP) policy 
• 35+ support and for-credit entrepreneurship programs 
https://uwaterloo.ca/institute-nanotechnology/research-waterloo-institute-nanotechnology/facilities-equipment/quantum-nano-centre 

3:54 Faculty of Science
• 17 undergraduate programs 
• School of Optometry and Vision Science 
• School of Pharmacy 
• 700+ research and teaching labs 
• Science Innovation Hub: test your ideas 
• Always in fashion: lab coats & goggles
https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/science

4:11 Faculty of Engineering
• 15 undergraduate programs 
• School of Architecture 
• Conrad School of Entrepreneurship and Business 
• The Engineering IDEAs Clinic 
• Mascot: The Tool, a pipe wrench 
https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/engineering

4:30 Claudette Millar Hall (CMH) / Waterloo Residences
• 100% first-year guarantee 
• 10 residences  
• Traditional & suite-style options 
• Support from dons and peer leaders 
• Living-Learning Communities  
https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/residence

4:50 University of Waterloo
Your Waterloo journey is just beginning. Find the right program for you, talk with a student ambassador, and connect with admissions experts: 
https://uwaterloo.ca/future

5:06 Land Acknowledgement
The University of Waterloo acknowledges it is situated on the Haldimand tract, the land granted to the Haudenosaunee of Six Nations of the Grand River in the Haldimand treaty of 1784. The Halidmand tract and surrounding area, including our Stratford Campus, is the traditional territory of the Attawandaron, Anishnaabeg, and Haudenosaunee people.
